feature: A title typed over a video reads without restyling
summary: Press T over a recording and type, and the words come out as a title: white, bold Georgia, a tenth of the picture tall, with a soft shadow, like the mock's 'Ship it faster.'. Text on a still picture still comes out as it always has. The words you type now also show while you type them in Georgia; before, a Georgia draft was invisible until you pressed Return.
setup: Photonz Dev, release Next, no flag changed from its default.

try.do: Press T, click on the picture and type a few words.
Press Command Return, then V. The Text section reads Georgia, 80 px, Bold on a 1280 by 800 recording.
Change the Size to 48 px, then press T and type a second title. It comes out at 48 px.
Open a screenshot, press T and type. It is 24 px regular in your foreground colour, as before.

evaluate: Does the first title read at a glance on your own recordings without touching the Text section?
Is a tenth of the picture height the right starting size? The mock and Premiere both land there; the task guessed a twentieth, which is the size captions already use.
Is Georgia the right face, or would you rather titles start in SF Pro Bold? The mock asks for the system serif, which the app cannot draw, so Georgia stands in.
When you pick a foreground colour while a video is open, should the next title really follow it, the way Photoshop's type tool does?
rough: Side by side with the video mock's 'Ship it faster.' title: same white, bold weight, soft dark shadow and size (a tenth of the height, the mock is 26 of 248). The face differs: the mock asks for the system serif, the app draws Georgia. The mock's title sits top left; ours lands where you click.

White words over a white part of the frame (the sample's card) are still hard to read: the soft shadow from the mock is not enough there. The app does not pick a colour from the frame under the words.
While typing, the draft has no shadow, so white words over a light area are hard to see until Return.
The Text section does not show while the text tool is merely held over a video, so you only see the title's size and font after the first title is placed.

The editing-session walk still stops at its cross dissolve step, before its title picture, because of a transition picker failure another task owns. The title part was checked with a copy of that walk that skips the transition.
